content.text:
Four files outside `packages/lib/currencyConversions.ts` import `convertFromSmallestToPresentableCurrencyUnit` from `@calcom/lib/currencyConversions` and call it. I searched `packages` and `apps` and found no test files that reference the function.

- `packages/lib/currencyConversions.ts` defines it (line 28) and calls it in its own `formatPrice` (line 69).
- `packages/app-store/hitpay/lib/PaymentService.ts` calls it at line 113.
- `packages/app-store/hitpay/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx` calls it at line 92.
- `packages/app-store/stripepayment/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx` calls it at line 111.
- `packages/app-store/paypal/lib/Paypal.ts` calls it at line 89.
- `packages/app-store/paypal/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx` calls it at line 85.

Three other files contain the same function name but don't use the `packages/lib` one, so I left them out of the list:
- `packages/app-store/btcpayserver` defines its own copy in `lib/currencyOptions.ts`. Its `PaymentService.ts` and `EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx` import that copy.
- `packages/app-store/hitpay/lib/currencyConversions.ts` also defines its own copy. Nothing I found imports it, because hitpay's files import from `@calcom/lib` instead.

<files>
packages/lib/currencyConversions.ts
packages/app-store/hitpay/lib/PaymentService.ts
packages/app-store/hitpay/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx
packages/app-store/stripepayment/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx
packages/app-store/paypal/lib/Paypal.ts
packages/app-store/paypal/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx
</files>
